## About
Empower Family Chiropractic is the Lakeway practice of Dr. Jeannique Norbert, known to her patients as Dr. J. She cares for patients of all ages, from newborns and kids to expecting moms, new parents and adults, with gentle, safe, effective chiropractic care.
Dr. J earned her doctor of chiropractic degree from Texas Chiropractic College and has completed specialty training in pediatric care through the International Chiropractic Pediatric Association. She also holds certificate training in the Webster Technique for pregnancy care. She takes the time to understand your goals and builds a care plan around your health history.
Families rate us 5 from 92 reviews on Google. If we're not the right fit for you, we'll help you find the practitioner who is.

## Services
- Pediatric Chiropractic: Gentle chiropractic care for babies, kids and teens, with a room made just for them.
- Pregnancy: Care that helps your body find balance while you're expecting.
- Webster Technique: A specific chiropractic analysis and adjusting technique for pregnant women. Dr. J holds certificate training in it.
- Postpartum chiropractic: Support for new moms as your body recovers after baby arrives.
- Family chiropractic: Care for every member of the family, from infancy to adulthood.
- Wellness Care: For patients who simply want to keep feeling good with regular chiropractic care.
- Sports and performance: During her training, Dr. J worked with the Rice University athletic department to help athletes back to peak performance.
- Accidents and trauma: Care for you or your child after an auto accident.

## FAQ
Q: How do I book an appointment?
A: You can call us, fill out the form on our site, or book an appointment online.

Q: Is there anything I should do before my first visit?
A: Yes. Please take a minute to fill out the new patient forms before your first session.

Q: Do you offer family plans?
A: We do. We can put together a customized plan for you and your family. Individual plans are available too.

Q: Are payment plans available?
A: Flexible payment plans can be arranged for those who choose our time-of-service savings rates. Give the office a call to learn more.

Q: Where are you located?
A: We're in Lakeway, just down the hill behind The Grove.
